N° 04Legal education platform2025 to 2026

Droit Facile

Cameroonian law, finally clear, for citizens and for jurists.

Visit loi-pour-tous.lovable.app →Watch the purpose

I

Purpose

Explain the law in plain language, point to the right procedure, and help people draft the documents they need. The educational content is free, always.

II

The problem

Legal information lives in scattered codes and expensive consultations. A tenant, a trader or a student has no first door to knock on, and jurists answer the same twenty questions all day.

III

What I built

Topics written for readers with no legal training, with steps, documents and deadlines. An assistant that answers with its sources shown and says that it does not replace a lawyer. A drafting room for letters and simple contracts. A foundations section. Professional tools priced in CFA francs; civic content stays open.

IV

How it works

French first, mobile first. The assistant is grounded in the written topics so its answers can be checked. Plans are separated from content so nothing educational is gated.

V

Craft

Terracotta and ivory, a warm serif, imagery that places the law in an African courtyard.

VI

The purpose, in motion

A short motion design made for this book: four beats, one drawn shape each, the reason the project exists. Tap it to step through.

Droit Facile
VII

In short

  • Plain language topics with the procedure
  • An assistant that shows its sources
  • Document drafting from a few answers
  • Civic content never gated
